question: Which country has the MOST pyramids?

post.premise: The land of the pyramids is not the land with the most pyramids
post.bait: Egypt, Mexico or Sudan — which did you pick? 👇
keywords: which country has the most pyramids

youtube.title: Which country has the most pyramids? It's not Egypt 🏜️
youtube.description:
Egypt, Mexico or the third one? The country everyone pictures when they hear 'pyramid' is not the one with the most of them. Another nation on the same river has nearly twice as many, steeper and smaller, and its kings once ruled Egypt itself as pharaohs.
Guess before the map lights up, then see the count, the royal site, and the long river journey between the two.
Which did you pick?

intent: A river journey in reverse: the count that beats Egypt, the kings who ruled Egypt, then the long Nile road from the forgotten pyramids to the famous ones.

v04.text: Sudan. The Kingdom of Kush built more than 200 pyramids along the Nile, nearly twice Egypt's count.

v05.text: Egypt has about 138. Sudan's are steeper and slimmer, up to 30 metres tall, and most stand at Meroe.

v06.text: Kush was no copycat. From 744 BC its kings ruled Egypt itself as pharaohs, for nearly a century.

v07.text: Meroe lies 200 kilometres north of Khartoum, and some 1600 kilometres up the Nile from Giza.

facts.text: built by the Kingdom of Kush

research.topic: Country with the most pyramids: Sudan (Kingdom of Kush / Nubian pyramids, 200+ at Meroë, Nuri, El-Kurru and Jebel Barkal) versus Egypt (about 138 known).

myths.myth: Egypt has the most pyramids because it has the most famous ones.
myths.reality: Egypt has about 138 known pyramids; Sudan's Kushite sites hold more than 200, most of them at Meroë.

landscape.our_gap: Feed clips say 'Sudan has more pyramids' as a one-liner; nobody runs the Egyptian count against the Sudanese one, pins Meroë and then draws the Nile distance up to Giza on a moving map.
